Parameters for isotope annotation

Source: R/AllClasses.R, R/methods-show.R
IsotopologueParam.Rd

IsotopologueParam() creates the parameter object for annotateIsotopes(). Isotope patterns are searched within each feature group with MetaboCoreUtils::isotopologues(), which checks both the mass differences and the intensity ratios of the candidate peaks.

Usage

IsotopologueParam(
  ppm = 10,
  tolerance = 0.005,
  polarity = c("positive", "negative"),
  subset = integer(),
  value = "into"
)

# S4 method for class 'IsotopologueParam'
show(object)

Arguments

ppm

numeric(1) relative m/z tolerance (in ppm) passed to MetaboCoreUtils::isotopologues().

tolerance

numeric(1) absolute m/z tolerance passed to MetaboCoreUtils::isotopologues().

polarity

character(1), "positive" or "negative". Only used for the +/- suffix of the labels.

subset

integer with the indices of the samples used to compute the representative intensity of each feature (the median over these samples). An empty vector (the default) uses all samples. Only used by the XcmsExperiment method.

value

character(1) the type of feature value used for the intensities, see xcms::featureValues(). Only used by the XcmsExperiment method.

object

an IsotopologueParam object.

Value

An IsotopologueParam object.

See also

annotateIsotopes(), AdductVoteParam()

Examples

IsotopologueParam()
#> Object of class "IsotopologueParam"
#>  ppm: 10 
#>  tolerance: 0.005 
#>  polarity: positive 
#>  value: into 
#>  subset: all samples 
IsotopologueParam(ppm = 5, polarity = "negative")
#> Object of class "IsotopologueParam"
#>  ppm: 5 
#>  tolerance: 0.005 
#>  polarity: negative 
#>  value: into 
#>  subset: all samples
